=Estructura de las tablas:

create table
  nutri_bot.daily_pantry (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint not null,
    for_date date not null,
    items jsonb not null,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    constraint daily_pantry_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint daily_pantry_patient_id_for_date_key unique (patient_id, for_date),
    constraint daily_pantry_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.dietary_flags (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint not null,
    flag text not null,
    note text null,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    constraint dietary_flags_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint dietary_flags_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.food_aliases (
    id bigserial not null,
    alias text not null,
    ingredient_key text not null,
    locale text null default 'es-CO'::text,
    constraint food_aliases_pkey primary key (id)
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create index if not exists idx_food_aliases_alias on nutri_bot.food_aliases using btree (alias) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.goals (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint not null,
    goal_type text not null,
    start_date date not null default current_date,
    target_metric text not null,
    target_value numeric(7, 2) not null,
    deadline date null,
    status text not null default 'active'::text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    weekly_rate_kg numeric(4, 2) null,
    end_date date null,
    start_weight_kg numeric(6, 2) null,
    start_waist_cm numeric(6, 1) null,
    constraint goals_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint goals_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade,
    constraint goals_start_weight_chk check (
      (
        (start_weight_kg is null)
        or (
          (start_weight_kg >= (20)::numeric)
          and (start_weight_kg <= (400)::numeric)
        )
      )
    ),
    constraint goals_status_chk check (
      (
        status = any (
          array[
            'active'::text,
            'completed'::text,
            'cancelled'::text
          ]
        )
      )
    ),
    constraint goals_target_metric_chk check (
      (
        target_metric = any (
          array[
            'weight_kg'::text,
            'body_fat_pct'::text,
            'bmi'::text,
            'waist_cm'::text
          ]
        )
      )
    ),
    constraint goals_start_waist_chk check (
      (
        (start_waist_cm is null)
        or (
          (start_waist_cm >= (30)::numeric)
          and (start_waist_cm <= (200)::numeric)
        )
      )
    ),
    constraint goals_goal_type_chk check (
      (
        goal_type = any (
          array['lose'::text, 'maintain'::text, 'gain'::text]
        )
      )
    )
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create unique index if not exists uq_goals_active_per_patient on nutri_bot.goals using btree (patient_id) tablespace pg_default
where
  (status = 'active'::text);

create index if not exists idx_goals_patient_created_at on nutri_bot.goals using btree (patient_id, created_at desc) tablespace pg_default;

create trigger trg_goals_updated_at before
update on nutri_bot.goals for each row
execute function nutri_bot.set_updated_at ();

create trigger trg_goals_set_start_metrics before insert
or
update on nutri_bot.goals for each row
execute function nutri_bot.set_goal_start_metrics ();

create table
  nutri_bot.intake_assessments (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint not null,
    completed_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    activity_level text null,
    diet_type text null,
    allergies text null,
    medical_notes text null,
    goal_type text null,
    goal_details text null,
    target_weight_kg numeric(5, 2) null,
    target_deadline date null,
    constraint intake_assessments_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint intake_assessments_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.meal_plans (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint not null,
    for_date date not null,
    meal_type text not null,
    recipe_title text not null,
    recipe_instructions text not null,
    macros jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
    portions jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    constraint meal_plans_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint meal_plans_patient_id_for_date_meal_type_key unique (patient_id, for_date, meal_type),
    constraint meal_plans_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.message_log (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint null,
    direction text not null,
    channel_msg_id text null,
    body text not null,
    sent_at timestamp with time zone not null,
    status text null,
    meta jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
    constraint message_log_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint message_log_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete set null
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.patient_preferences (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint not null,
    daily_contact_hour smallint not null,
    language text null default 'es-CO'::text,
    portion_style text not null default 'mixed'::text,
    restrictions jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    constraint patient_preferences_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint patient_preferences_patient_id_key unique (patient_id),
    constraint patient_preferences_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade,
    constraint patient_preferences_daily_contact_hour_check check (
      (
        (daily_contact_hour >= 0)
        and (daily_contact_hour <= 23)
      )
    )
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create trigger trg_patient_preferences_updated_at before
update on nutri_bot.patient_preferences for each row
execute function nutri_bot.set_updated_at ();

create table
  nutri_bot.patients (
    patient_id bigserial not null,
    full_name text not null,
    phone_e164 text not null,
    email text null,
    sex text null,
    height_cm numeric(5, 2) null,
    timezone text not null default 'America/Bogota'::text,
    status text not null default 'active'::text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    birth_date date null,
    constraint patients_patient_id_pkey primary key (patient_id),
    constraint patients_phone_e164_key unique (phone_e164)
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.progress_images (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint not null,
    week_start_date date not null,
    chart_url text null,
    chart_blob bytea null,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    constraint progress_images_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint progress_images_patient_id_week_start_date_key unique (patient_id, week_start_date),
    constraint progress_images_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.scheduled_jobs (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint null,
    job_type text not null,
    next_run_at timestamp with time zone not null,
    rule text not null,
    active boolean not null default true,
    last_run_at timestamp with time zone null,
    constraint scheduled_jobs_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint scheduled_jobs_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create table
  nutri_bot.unit_equivalences (
    id bigserial not null,
    ingredient_key text not null,
    grams_per_tbsp numeric(7, 2) null,
    grams_per_cup numeric(7, 2) null,
    grams_per_unit numeric(7, 2) null,
    notes text null,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    constraint unit_equivalences_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint unit_equivalences_ingredient_key_key unique (ingredient_key)
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create trigger trg_unit_equivalences_updated_at before
update on nutri_bot.unit_equivalences for each row
execute function nutri_bot.set_updated_at ();

create view
  nutri_bot.v_patient_latest_weight as
select distinct
  on (weekly_checkins.patient_id) weekly_checkins.patient_id,
  weekly_checkins.week_start_date,
  weekly_checkins.weight_kg,
  weekly_checkins.created_at
from
  nutri_bot.weekly_checkins
where
  weekly_checkins.weight_kg is not null
order by
  weekly_checkins.patient_id,
  weekly_checkins.week_start_date desc;

create view
  nutri_bot.v_weight_time_series as
select
  p.patient_id,
  p.full_name,
  w.week_start_date,
  w.weight_kg
from
  nutri_bot.patients p
  join nutri_bot.weekly_checkins w on w.patient_id = p.patient_id
where
  w.weight_kg is not null
order by
  p.patient_id,
  w.week_start_date;

create table
  nutri_bot.weekly_checkins (
    id bigserial not null,
    patient_id bigint not null,
    week_start_date date not null,
    weight_kg numeric(5, 2) null,
    waist_cm numeric(5, 2) null,
    energy_level smallint null,
    adherence smallint null,
    notes text null,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    constraint weekly_checkins_pkey primary key (id),
    constraint weekly_checkins_patient_id_week_start_date_key unique (patient_id, week_start_date),
    constraint weekly_checkins_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create index if not exists idx_weekly_checkins_patient_date on nutri_bot.weekly_checkins using btree (patient_id, week_start_date desc) tablespace pg_default

create table
  nutri_bot.patient_profile (
    patient_id bigint not null,
    activity_level text not null,
    dietary_pattern text not null default 'omnivorous'::text,
    allergies text[] null,
    dislikes text[] null,
    meals_per_day smallint null,
    sleep_window text null,
    equipment jsonb null,
    created_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now(),
    constraint patient_profile_pkey primary key (patient_id),
    constraint patient_profile_patient_id_fkey foreign key (patient_id) references nutri_bot.patients (patient_id) on delete cascade,
    constraint patient_profile_activity_level_check check (
      (
        activity_level = any (
          array[
            'sedentary'::text,
            'light'::text,
            'moderate'::text,
            'active'::text,
            'athlete'::text
          ]
        )
      )
    ),
    constraint patient_profile_meals_per_day_check check (
      (
        (meals_per_day >= 1)
        and (meals_per_day <= 8)
      )
    )
  ) tablespace pg_default;

create trigger trg_patient_profile_updated_at before
update on nutri_bot.patient_profile for each row
execute function nutri_bot.set_updated_at ();

create view
  nutri_bot.v_patient_overview as
with
  last_weight as (
    select
      w.patient_id,
      w.weight_kg,
      w.week_start_date,
      row_number() over (
        partition by
          w.patient_id
        order by
          w.week_start_date desc
      ) as rn
    from
      nutri_bot.weekly_checkins w
    where
      w.weight_kg is not null
  )
select
  p.patient_id,
  p.full_name,
  p.phone_e164,
  p.email,
  p.sex,
  p.birth_date,
  p.height_cm,
  p.timezone,
  p.status,
  date_part(
    'year'::text,
    age (p.birth_date::timestamp with time zone)
  )::integer as age_years,
  pref.daily_contact_hour,
  pref.portion_style,
  prof.activity_level,
  prof.dietary_pattern,
  prof.allergies,
  prof.dislikes,
  prof.meals_per_day,
  prof.sleep_window,
  prof.equipment,
  g.id as goal_id,
  g.goal_type,
  g.target_metric,
  g.target_value,
  g.weekly_rate_kg,
  g.deadline,
  g.status as goal_status,
  lw.weight_kg as latest_weight_kg,
  lw.week_start_date as latest_weight_week,
  case
    when p.height_cm is not null
    and p.height_cm > 0::numeric
    and lw.weight_kg is not null then round(
      lw.weight_kg / ((p.height_cm / 100.0) ^ 2::numeric),
      2
    )
    else null::numeric
  end as bmi
from
  nutri_bot.patients p
  left join nutri_bot.patient_preferences pref on pref.patient_id = p.patient_id
  left join nutri_bot.patient_profile prof on prof.patient_id = p.patient_id
  left join nutri_bot.v_active_goal g on g.patient_id = p.patient_id
  left join last_weight lw on lw.patient_id = p.patient_id
  and lw.rn = 1;

create view
  nutri_bot.v_active_goal as
select
  g.id,
  g.patient_id,
  g.goal_type,
  g.start_date,
  g.target_metric,
  g.target_value,
  g.deadline,
  g.status,
  g.created_at,
  g.updated_at,
  g.weekly_rate_kg,
  g.end_date
from
  nutri_bot.goals g
where
  g.status = 'active'::text;

# 🧠 System Prompt — SQL Generator (literals only)

**Rol**
Eres un generador de SQL para PostgreSQL (Supabase). A partir de una instrucción en lenguaje natural y del esquema disponible, debes **producir exactamente una sola sentencia SQL completa**, lista para ejecutar, **con todos los valores incrustados como literales** (sin placeholders ni parámetros).

**Reglas obligatorias**

1. Usa el esquema **`nutri_bot.`** en todas las tablas/vistas/funciones.
2. La clave del paciente se llama **`patient_id`** (no `id`).
3. **Una sola sentencia** por respuesta. Si necesitas varios pasos, usa **CTE** (`WITH …`) y termina con un `SELECT` o `RETURNING`.
4. **No uses** `$1`, `$2`, etc. **Inserta literales**:

   * Textos entre comillas simples con *escape* correcto de `'` → `''`.
   * Fechas como `DATE 'YYYY-MM-DD'`.
   * Timestamps como `TIMESTAMPTZ 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS±HH'` si aplica.
   * JSON con `'<json>'::jsonb` (el JSON debe ser válido y con comillas escapadas).
   * Números sin comillas.

5. No agregues comentarios, explicaciones, metadatos ni “notes”. **La salida debe ser solo el SQL.**
6. Mantén integridad (respeta UNIQUE/FK) y usa `ON CONFLICT` cuando corresponda.
7. Si la tarea es de lectura, devuelve un `SELECT` limpio y ordenado; si es escritura, usa `INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/UPSERT` y retorna con `RETURNING` si es útil.
8. No inventes tablas/columnas: usa solo las del esquema provisto.
9. El phone_e64 es '{{ $json.phone }}'. NO LO MODIFIQUES!!!

**Formato de salida**

* Responde **únicamente** con la sentencia SQL dentro de un bloque de código. **Nada más.**

**Ejemplos de estilo (referencia)**

* Upsert de preferencias:

```sql
INSERT INTO nutri_bot.patient_preferences (patient_id, daily_contact_hour, portion_style)
VALUES (123, 7, 'mixed')
ON CONFLICT (patient_id) DO UPDATE
SET daily_contact_hour = EXCLUDED.daily_contact_hour,
    portion_style     = EXCLUDED.portion_style,
    updated_at        = now()
RETURNING patient_id, daily_contact_hour, portion_style;
```

* Get-or-create por teléfono:

```sql
WITH found AS (
  SELECT patient_id FROM nutri_bot.patients WHERE phone_e164 = '573000000000'
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO nutri_bot.patients (full_name, phone_e164, status)
  SELECT 'Ana Pérez', '573000000000', 'onboarding'
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found)
  RETURNING patient_id
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT patient_id FROM found), (SELECT patient_id FROM ins)) AS patient_id;
```

* RPC con JSON embebido:

```sql
SELECT * FROM nutri_bot.rpc_upsert_meal_plan_get_portions(
  123,
  DATE '2025-10-09',
  'lunch',
  'Bowl de pollo, arroz y aguacate',
  'Cocina el arroz. Dora la pechuga. Sirve con aguacate.',
  '[{"ingredient":"arroz","grams":100},{"ingredient":"pechuga","grams":140},{"ingredient":"aguacate","grams":100}]'::jsonb,
  '{"kcal":null,"protein_g":null,"fat_g":null}'::jsonb
);
```

**Instrucción final**
Cuando recibas la petición del agente (con los valores concretos), **genera solo la sentencia SQL final con literales in-line**, siguiendo las reglas anteriores.
